serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Damn, I couldn’t catch anything…
Mrs. Fisher: No luck this time, huh.
You: No wonder, I have no talent in fishing.
#mrsfisher.face.angry
Mrs. Fisher: Quit your yapping, kid! That was just your first time. If this is enough to break your spirit, you don’t have what it takes to be a real fisherman.
#mrsfisher.face.normal
You: Well, consider my spirit broken then.
Mrs. Fisher: Wait a second kid. If you promise me to catch something later, on your own, I will give you this rod.
